text:
samir: Hey team, quick questions before I book for Berlin next month: 1) I bought a refundable flight on my personal card but the return leg was put on the corporate card by the travel agency (split itineraries). How should I submit that? 2) I sometimes don't get receipts for hostels/small BnBs what do I do if I lose a receipt? 3) I might want to buy an extra-legroom seat on the long-haul is that company reimbursable? 4) Is it possible to request a cash travel advance for meals on the ground? 5) conference provides lunch on two days can I still claim per-diem for the day?

liz (People Ops): nice list, thanks. Short answers: 1) submit both charges but only request reimbursement for the personal-card portion; attach the corporate card statement line showing the corporate charge so finance knows it was covered. 2) if you lose a receipt, upload an affidavit ("missing receipt form") in Expensify and include a clear explanation and the approximate amount; finance can approve up to policy limits. 3) seat upgrades are non-reimbursable by default unless pre-approved by your manager for business-critical reasons (long-haul >10h, health reasons, etc.). If pre-approved, include manager's approval in the expense notes. 4) cash advances are available for international trips >5 days or where per-diem won't cover vendor constraints request via the Travel Advance form at least 10 business days before departure and get manager sign-off. 5) conference-provided meals reduce the per-diem on a per-meal basis (we deduct the conference meal value, not the whole day).

samir: awesome. for #1 the travel agent gave one combined invoice with two charges. do i split that into two expense lines?

tanya (People Ops): yes split into two lines: one line for the corporate-card charge (mark as "charged to corporate card" and DO NOT request reimbursement for that line) and one line for your personal-card charge with the reimbursement request. Attach the single itemized invoice and add a short note mapping line items to payment methods.

samir: lost a hostel receipt before. would finance definitely reject?

josh (Finance): Not automatically. For small amounts (<$75) we accept the missing receipt affidavit + booking confirmation (email or reservation screenshot) plus a bank/cc statement showing the charge. For larger amounts finance will ask for more documentation or manager approval. Always fill out the missing-receipt form in Expensify.

samir: if I use a shared cab with three people and pay full fare, what's the preferred way?

liz (People Ops): upload the receipt, create one expense for the total and in the notes list passengers and your share. If you split on Venmo/PayPal later, attach that screenshot too. For rides paid on company card, just attach the receipt and mark it as corporate card.

samir: sample note to paste into expense?

liz (People Ops): paste this into the expense notes:
```
Trip: Berlin conf 2026 - 2026-06-12
Expense: Taxi from TXL to hotel - total 48 EUR - passengers: Samir (share 16 EUR), Lina (share 16 EUR), Marco (share 16 EUR). My reimbursement requested: 16 EUR -> converted to USD at transaction rate.
Documentation: taxi receipt + payment screenshot attached.
```

finance-bot: Travel policy: https://redwoodintranet.company/travel-policy 10-day advance window, per-diem table, missing receipt affidavit, and currency-conversion rules. Use the "International travel" section for exchange-rate examples.

samir: one more on per-diem conference lunches provided on day 2 & 3. I should claim full per-diem and then note which meals were covered?

tanya (People Ops): choose the per-diem option in Expensify and mark lunches (Day 2 lunch, Day 3 lunch) as provided. The system will deduct those meal portions. If you prefer, you can claim actuals for meals instead of per-diem but you must upload itemized receipts.

samir: got it. final: how long til reimbursement? last trip took ~4 weeks.

josh (Finance): Typical turnaround is 2 payroll cycles post-approval (~2-3 weeks). Delays happen if receipts are missing or manager sign-off is pending. For urgent reimbursements (medical or critical vendor payments), tag expense with "urgent" and notify finance; we can expedite.

samir: perfect, i'll get approvals and the advance request in next week. thanks everyone :wave:
